emotional_tone: Professional, reliable, premium, secure, and clear

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-slate-900
rules.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200. Must have desktop links and primary CTA 'Offerte aanvragen'.
components_strategy.hero: Split layout or image with gradient overlay (bg-slate-900/40) for text contrast. High impact H1.
components_strategy.service_cards: Use raw Tailwind (not Shadcn cards). Flat background `#F8FAFC`, 1px border `#E2E8F0`. Hover state: `-translate-y-1 shadow-xl border-sky-600`.
components_strategy.gallery: Grid layout. Images must have `aspect-[4/3]` and `object-cover`. On hover, scale image slightly inside overflow-hidden container.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn inputs and textareas for 'Offerte aanvragen' and Contact. Focus states must use `focus:ring-sky-600`.
components_strategy.whatsapp_button: Fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-full w-14 h-14 bg-[#25D366] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.js files, not .tsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body (add Google Fonts link in index.html).
Match colors exactly as described in the colors object. The theme must feel professional and high-trust.
Ensure the hero has a dark overlay if text is over an image, or use a clean split layout.
For the Projecten gallery, implement a modern hover effect (zoom in on image slightly, show description overlay).
Implement the WhatsApp floating button fixed to bottom right corner using the green color.
Create the contact/quote form using clean, modern inputs. Include validation for Offerte aanvraag.
Follow 'generous spacing' rules: do not compress sections. Use py-20 to py-32 for gaps between distinct sections.
Build a sticky navigation bar with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur). Ensure the primary CTA 'Offerte aanvragen' stands out in the nav.
